homepageEditorial.capabilities: What I Do uses four title-focused, title-only capability cards with the exact titles Creative Strategy & Digital Marketing; Visual Design & Branding; Web Apps & Digital Solutions; Generative AI & Automation. No descriptions, numbering, large raster screenshots, or false action targets appear. Decorative CSS geometry and Lucide symbols convey strategy tiles, typography/palette/layers, browser windows, and an AI workflow; scenes are hidden from assistive technology. Cards stack on mobile within existing 20px page gutters. From 768px the first and last span two columns, with the middle pair sharing a row. Gaps are 12px mobile and 16px from 768px. Insets are 20px mobile and 24px from 768px; the existing desktop 32px outer gutters and maximum 1280px shell remain. The section follows About after 48px with 24px heading separation. Cards use 16px corners, warm-white fill at .025 alpha, a 1px warm-white border at .1 alpha, and 12px backdrop blur. An upper-left radial orange glow at .075 alpha and miniature-scene shadows are explicit local exceptions to the flat interface. Minimum heights are 204px mobile and 224px from 768px; the full-width cards use 176px from that breakpoint, with their scenes at right in 44% width and headings at left in 48%. Titles use 20px/1.3, 18px below 380px, and 24px from 768px, paired with 20px orange icons. One 0.7s GSAP card entrance uses expo.out, 12px movement and 0.8 opacity with reduced-motion/static fallback. Four versioned CMS title fields replace the previous presentation. Older layouts migrate at render time, applying the supplied titles once while preserving future migrated-title edits. Old descriptions and fifth-title values remain stored without production writes. A sanitizer-safe class marker preserves future saved visual edits, and repeated rendering does not duplicate cards. About retains its default canvas, no section border, and orange heading emphasis. Current browser captures are unavailable, so these source-derived rules do not assert visual approval. See `docs/briefs/2026-10-20-capabilities-reference-redesign.md`.

dos: **Do** keep Req Take Video's two browser panels on a white/silver studio background with the larger schedule at left and the supporting request panel at right. Preserve teal UI and actual content, soft physical shadows, 4:3 contain framing, CMS image editing, and the existing title, slug, case narrative, and destination. Keep aqua environments, rings, stages, and sparkles out of this artwork.
**Do** preserve separate structural and interactive border colors.
**Do** keep actual artwork prominent, with captions outside its frame except for homepage design and video showcase bottom title overlays.

**Do** retain visible action labels, keyboard focus, and explicit loading or failure messages; menu, social, and carousel pause/resume controls use icons with accessible names and tooltips, with state-specific names for pause/resume.
**Do** respect reduced motion and let mobile action groups wrap.

For Internal Listing Hub, keep the two-app mobile presentation in one 4:3 cover with complete graphite phones, actual white/green app interfaces, a forest-green artwork background and soft physical shadows. Keep copy outside the thumbnail. Preserve Works CMS editing of the cover, concise Indonesian narrative and both app link blocks. Authored copy uses no em dash or en dash and no unverified quantitative impact claims. This is project artwork, not a new public interface palette.

**Do** preserve PROGRAM MBG's three real mobile screens in its 4:3 cover, keep its navy, teal, and gold inside the artwork, and retain CMS editing of cover and narrative. Treat screenshot points as interface content rather than outcome metrics; authored copy uses no em dash or en dash.

**Do** present Meta Ads Report as a single white/silver display close-up with a static magnified Rekap Iklan panel over a subdued real dashboard. Use existing batch metrics and blue/green accents without inventing application features. Keep the cover and description CMS editable, preserve existing case claims and blocks, and retain the portfolio's dark/orange interface.

**Do** use Daily App Gading as the portfolio name, replacing Mega App Gading. Preserve its 4:3 regular diagonal white/silver grid: parallel panels, uniform gaps, matching radii, one shared rotation, and no overlap or independently floating screens. Central-lower Kanban anchors Prompt Generator upper left, Link Library upper right, Watermark Generator lower right, and cropped neighboring tiles. Keep original small UI accents and uniform soft shadows confined to artwork, with no device frames. Retain editable CMS fields and existing narrative, use /work/daily-app-gading, and preserve /work/mega-app-gading as a legacy alias with the stable internal item ID and external app destination. This supersedes the earlier floating three-screen collage.

rules.name: The Action and Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Use orange for intentional emphasis and interaction, including the existing full-color contact surface; it is not a blanket restriction to small accents.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Keep display, explanation, navigation, and controls in Manrope; hierarchy comes from scale, weight, spacing, and color.

rules.name: The Flat Interface Rule
rules.body: Keep interface surfaces flat by default; preserve soft screenshot shadows within artwork. The owner-approved scrolling header and four capability cards are scoped glass exceptions, not new treatments for ordinary controls or content rows.

keyCharacteristics: Large artwork leads; homepage design and video showcases use a bottom title overlay, while archive captions remain outside.
Confident sans headings and quieter, readable explanations.
Flat dark surfaces, thin dividers, and compact rectangular controls.
Orange actions and emphasis, with an orange contact surface.
Small interaction responses that respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** turn local artwork colors into new interface accents.
**Don't** apply the screenshot shadow to ordinary buttons, navigation, or content rows.
**Don't** import legacy admin or CV styling into the public showcase system.
**Don't** promote small pre-heading context lines or artwork kickers into a reusable heading pattern; these existing exceptions are not canonized by this document.
narrative.overview:
A near-black canvas gives actual work the visual space to carry Gading's creative marketing and problem-solving identity. Warm white, broad Manrope lettering, and clear orange actions make the interface confident without competing with the artwork. English headings and action labels sit alongside natural Indonesian explanations.

This records the implemented public showcase, work collections, and case-study system, scoped by the showcase body class. It does not govern the admin or CV surfaces. The palette and component rules are extracted from `public/assets/css/showcase.css`, the public homepage, and the public collection and case-study components; page composition remains in the surface briefs.
